thread:
sam: deploy-bot flagged rc5 build: transitive runtime vuln introduced via libc-utils 2.1.8 -> medium/high? need triage.
devops-bot: scan result: 1 HIGH (CVE-2024-9999) in transitive dependency libc-utils@2.1.8, introduced in build 2024-08-14. SBOM present. Recommendation: quarantine artifact until assessment.
priya: can you paste the vuln details? link?
devops-bot: https://scans.redwood/reports/rc5-1756662222.html. Vuln summary: local privilege escalation in specific syscall wrapper. Repro steps in report. Impact: low for our hosted API (sandboxed), higher for on-prem customers with privileged hosts.
jonah: interesting — rc5 includes a new runtime optimization layer that touches syscall wrappers. That increases exposure.
kate: CS: we have two on-prem customers in EU scheduled for RC5 next week. Need to decide fast.
priya: options: (A) quarantine RC5 and rebase runtime to libc-utils 2.1.7 and rebuild; (B) roll forward with a regional carveout (hosted-only EU hold + on-prem pause); (C) hotpatch runtime container with mitigation (drop capability CAP_SYS_ADMIN) and release quickpatch.
sam: security, what's your recommendation?
security-bot: triage notes: exploit requires CAP_SYS_ADMIN or privileged container mount. Hosted default runs without those caps; on-prem installs may vary. Recommendation: allow hosted rollout with temporary capability hardening and deny on-prem until patch. Need approval ticket and mitigation checklist.
jonah: we can add container capability drop at runtime in the orchestration layer quickly. It's an allowable mitigation for hosted. That means no code change.
priya: how long to rebuild without libc-utils 2.1.8? around 3-4 hours for CI+smoke. Hotpatch + orchestration change could be done in ~1h.
kate: from CS: put a hold on all on-prem deployments and notify customers ASAP. We can offer a scheduled patch window.
sam: propose action: start hosted phased rollout (US first) with capability drop + strict canary (1% 30m), hold EU and on-prem. If passed, ramp. Meanwhile start rebuild and test for full replace by EOD. Does security sign off?
security-bot: sign-off conditional: (1) capability drop enforced at runtime (drop CAP_SYS_ADMIN and CAP_SYS_RAWIO), (2) monitoring for syscall errors enabled, (3) approval ticket updated with SBOM delta and mitigation evidence.
priya: I'll file approval exception: https://approvals.redwood/requests/RC5-1756662222 with mitigation notes.
jonah: orchestration patch ready: ```kubectl set security-context deployment/inference-runtime --c group=runtime --drop=CAP_SYS_ADMIN,CAP_SYS_RAWIO``` will roll pods with config.
devops-bot: orchestration patch applied to canary-ns-us-canary. Canary started: rc5-us-canary. Metrics: https://obs.redwood/canaries/rc5-us.
kate: CS notified customers: "We detected a transitive dependency flagged in RC5. Hosted rollout proceeding with mitigation; on-prem is paused. We will follow up with patch ETA."
priya: QA will run focused syscall regression tests on rebuild branch. ETA 4h.
sam: decision log: Hosted canary proceed (US only) with capability hardening; EU + on-prem paused. Rebuild branch + smoke tests prioritized. Update release notes "SCOPED: transitive runtime CVE mitigated via runtime capability hardening; on-prem deployments paused until patch."
on-prem mention: kate: will coordinate customer comms and schedule patch windows.
security-bot: attach SBOM delta: https://artifacts.redwood/sboms/rc4-vs-rc5-delta.json. Evidence of capability drop logs: https://obs.redwood/logs/capdrop-rc5-canary.txt.
jonah: monitor shows no syscall error spikes in canary after cap drop for 20m.
priya: if we see any spike >0.5% syscall errors or 2xx->5xx increase, rollback immediately. Rollback command: ```/rollback redwood/inference:rc4 --scope canary-us --reason "runtime-cve-canary-failure"```
sam: thanks all. I'll update the release-ticket and close once rebuild passes QA and we publish signed artifacts.
kate: closing loop with CS and scheduled patch window for on-prem customers tomorrow morning.
priya: adding note to release notes and approvals: "RC5: transitive CVE (CVE-2024-9999) mitigated for hosted with ephemeral capability hardening; on-prem paused; full rebuild in progress."
